Class GuiCorrectionScreen

it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.client.view.gui.guiScreens.GuiCorrectionScreen
public class GuiCorrectionScreen extends GuiGameScreen
Screen for the ship correction phase of the game. This screen is displayed when players need to fix issues with their ship construction, either due to invalid component placement or disconnected ship pieces. Players can select which ship piece to keep or which components to remove to fix their ship.

    • GuiCorrectionScreen

      public GuiCorrectionScreen(ClientModel model, ClientControllerInterface controller, ShipCorrectionState state)
      Constructs a GuiCorrectionScreen with the specified model, controller, and correction state. Initializes the screen based on the current state of the player's ship, displaying appropriate messages and controls based on whether the ship is valid, broken (disconnected), or has invalid component placement.
      Parameters:
      model - The client model containing all game data
      controller - The controller for sending commands to the server
      state - The current ship correction state
